item.title: Gresham man arrested for child sex abuse, making explosives, police say
item.description: A Gresham man was arrested Wednesday on child sex abuse charges and for allegedly making explosive devices, authorities announced.

item.title: Eight ex-inmates sue Clark County for alleged sexual abuse at juvenile center
item.description: Eight former inmates of Clark County Juvenile Justice Center have filed a lawsuit against the facility alleging sexual abuse by multiple staff members, spanning from 1978 to 2014, and are seeking $302 billion for the physical and emotional distress they endured.

item.title: 'Sad and shocking': Woman's body discovered in Washington woods leads to arrest of 66-year-old man
item.description: A 66-year-old man was arrested Tuesday after the body of a woman was discovered in the woods in eastern Clark County.
